_readme: All business details live here. Anything in [[DOUBLE BRACKETS]] is a placeholder — replace it with real info. Run `npm run build:check` to list what's left.
name: CCerenity's
tagline: Homemade treats, baked to order in Fort Wayne
_logoNote: logo.jpg is the 640x640 logo post from Instagram (Oct 10, 2025). Replace it with the original file if you have one.
heroAlt: CCerenity's logo: Taste of CCerenity, Homemade Treats, Fort Wayne, IN
_heroNote: Big image on the home page. Set to e.g. "/assets/img/hero.jpg" (square, ~1000px). A treat photo or a high-resolution logo both work.
_emailNote: Owner's email, shown publicly on the site (footer, Pickup & Contact). Also use it for Netlify order-form notifications. If you later register ccerenitys.com with email, you can switch to contact@ccerenitys.com.

pickup.addressNote: The exact pickup address is sent with your order confirmation.
